New Student Orientation Program (NSOP) 2026 Dining Service

The following dates of service are for incoming First-Year, Transfer, Combined Plan, and Exchange students, as well as students supporting NSOP programming. Dining service for returning upperclass and graduate students does not begin until Friday, September 4.

NSOP Dining Schedule

Saturday, August 29, 2026

Dinner service will be provided only to international first-year students who checked into Columbia Housing that day and their families. Please refer to communications from NSOP administrators for times and locations of service.
